ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a terrestrial food chain with upward arrows from Plant to Caterpillar, from Caterpillar to Lizard, and from Lizard to Snake. Reasoning: The arrow from Lizard to Snake indicates snakes depend on lizards as food. If lizards decrease, snakes have less food available, so snakes decrease.
